requirement.title: Sign in to the storefront
requirement.description: Registered shoppers sign in with a username and password to reach the product catalogue. Locked accounts must not get in.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a valid standard account, when the shopper signs in, then the product list titled "Products" is shown.
Given a locked-out account, when the shopper signs in, then the error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown and the shopper stays on the login page.
Given a wrong password, when the shopper signs in, then the error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

requirement.title: Notes API: create notes and protect them
requirement.description: Signed-in users manage their own notes through the REST API. Notes are private to their owner.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a valid token, when the user creates a note with a title, then the API answers 201 and returns the note with the caller as owner.
Given no token, when the notes list is requested, then the API answers 401 with error code "unauthorized".
Given a note owned by another user, when the user reads it, then the API answers 403 with error code "forbidden".
Given a title longer than 120 characters, when the user creates a note, then the API answers 400 with error code "validation_error".
